food-youxuan.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: travel food discovery card, landscape 3:2. Create one elegant editorial watercolor and gouache illustration, distinctly hand-painted rather than a photograph. Accurate, appetizing finished food fills about 75 percent of the frame. Three-quarter overhead composition, lightly textured warm ivory paper and restrained soft wash background, natural daylight, rich food color, fine brushwork and clear silhouettes that remain readable as a small card. No text, lettering, watermark, logo, collage, split panels or extra unrelated dishes. Subject: Jinan youxuan scallion spiral pastries, three small thick round golden baked savory buns on a shallow ceramic plate. Their defining shape is a coiled spiral of many delicate laminated pastry layers, concentric flaky rings visible from above, crisp deep-golden ridges and tiny scallion specks between layers. One tilted bun reveals the layered edge. No cinnamon sugar, icing, croissant horns, giant flat pancakes or sesame-covered rolls.
food-youxuan.modifications: WebP web asset, proportionally resized; no content retouching.
